mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS user_id, last_login_ip AS last_login_ip FROM tb_user WHERE del_flag = 0 AND last_login_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_login_ip != ''

SELECT CASE WHEN total_amount < 100 THEN '低消费' WHEN total_amount < 500 THEN '中消费' ELSE '高消费' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount FROM tb_order WHERE order_status = 3 AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) t GROUP BY level ORDER BY FIELD(level, '低消费', '中消费', '高消费')

SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS buy_count FROM tb_order_item oi JOIN tb_product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN tb_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND p.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY buy_count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT YEARWEEK(o.payment_time) AS week, YEARWEEK(o.payment_time) AS yearweek, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY YEARWEEK(o.payment_time) ORDER BY yearweek ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.total_price) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEARWEEK(o.payment_time), '周') AS week, YEARWEEK(o.payment_time) AS yearweek, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.total_price) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY YEARWEEK(o.payment_time) ORDER BY yearweek ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.total_price) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.total_price) AS sales_amount FROM tb_category c LEFT JOIN tb_product p ON c.category_id = p.category_id AND p.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_order_item oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id AND oi.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE c.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order o WHERE o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= CURDATE() AND o.payment_time < NOW()

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order o WHERE o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.payment_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order o WHERE o.order_status = 3 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND o.payment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND o.payment_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
